package agent

// Overlaid into package agent by TestStoredCatalogProgramCannotRunOutsideDispatch
// (#260). It does what the #257 review did: take the program the catalog
// stored for a workflow with a literal call input and run it through an
// observed engine, outside catalog dispatch. Where that compiles, it shows
// the hazard: the commit step is observed with, and receives, the workflow
// input instead of its literal. Where the catalog keeps the program behind
// agent/internal/catalogprogram, it must not compile.

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/well-prado/new-blok/contract/inspection"
	"github.com/well-prado/new-blok/internal/engine"
	"github.com/well-prado/new-blok/node"
)

type escape260Observer struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	events []inspection.Event
}

func (o *escape260Observer) Observe(e inspection.Event) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	o.events = append(o.events, e)
}

func TestEscape260RunStoredProgramObserved(t *testing.T) {
	r := &recorder{}
	n := newConfNodes(r)
	c := confCatalog(t, n)
	if err := RegisterWorkflow(c, literalWorkflow(n, object{"sku": "tea", "quantity": 1}), []byte(confOrderSchema), []byte(confCommitSchema), confManifest(), metadata()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c.mu.RLock()
	b := c.tools[confSpec.Name+"@"+confSpec.Version]
	c.mu.RUnlock()
	nodes := map[string]node.Any{"conf/reserve": n.reserve.Any(), "conf/commit": n.commit.Any()}
	o := &escape260Observer{}
	if _, err := engine.New(nodes).WithObserver(o).RunObserved(context.Background(), *b.program, object{"sku": "SECRET", "quantity": 2}, inspection.Invocation{RunID: "run-260", Principal: "reviewer"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	const literal = `{"quantity":1,"sku":"tea"}`
	for _, e := range o.events {
		if e.StepID == "commit" && e.Kind == inspection.StepProcessing && canonical260(t, e.Input) != literal {
			t.Errorf("HAZARD #260: StepProcessing observed commit input %s; the literal is %s", e.Input, literal)
		}
	}
	if got := r.inputs["conf/commit"]; len(got) != 1 || canonical260(t, []byte(got[0])) != literal {
		t.Errorf("HAZARD #260: the commit node received %v; the literal is %s", got, literal)
	}
}

func canonical260(t *testing.T, raw []byte) string {
	t.Helper()
	var value any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &value); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode %s: %v", raw, err)
	}
	out, _ := json.Marshal(value)
	return string(out)
}
